queries.query: CD274 CTLA4 bispecific antibody HCC hepatocellular carcinoma trial

hits.title: BiSpec Pairwise AI (Zhang et al. 2024)
hits.passage: BiSpec Pairwise AI (Zhang et al., J Cancer Res Clin Oncol 2024, DOI 10.1007/s00432-024-05740-3): machine-learning framework guiding bispecific antibody target-pair selection. XGBoost pairwise learning over biological features (target activity, safety, cell-type specificity, pathway mechanism, gene embeddings) predicts druggability of target combinations; RAG with GPT supplements predictions with feature rationales. Approved bispecific examples: glofitamab CD20xCD3, AK104 PD-1xCTLA4 (cadonilimab), AK112 PD-1xVEGF (ivonescimab), amivantamab EGFRxMET approved 2021 for NSCLC.

hits.title: ENREACH-PDAC-01 KN046 PDAC Phase 3
hits.passage: ENREACH-PDAC-01 (NCT05149326, Alphamab KN046-303): randomized double-blind Phase 3, ~408 patients, KN046 (PD-L1xCTLA4 bispecific) + gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel vs placebo + chemotherapy, 1L advanced PDAC. Primary endpoint overall survival; secondary PFS and ORR. Status UNKNOWN at last registry update (2024-03).

hits.title: eVOLVE-Lung02 volrustomig NSCLC (discontinued 2026-08 futility)
hits.passage: eVOLVE-Lung02 (NCT05984277, AstraZeneca D798AC00001): Phase 3, 895 patients, volrustomig (MEDI5752, PD-1xCTLA4 bispecific) + chemotherapy vs pembrolizumab + chemotherapy, 1L metastatic NSCLC PD-L1 <50%. Dual primary endpoints PFS and OS in PD-L1-negative participants. Status ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING at registry fetch; sponsor discontinued 2026-08-17 for futility (IDMC: PFS/OS unlikely met). Drug overall still investigational in other indications.

hits.title: NCI: Zenocutuzumab for NRG1+ NSCLC/PDAC (accelerated approval)
hits.passage: NCI Cancer Currents Blog, 26 Mar 2025: FDA accelerated approval of zenocutuzumab (Bizengri) for NRG1-fusion NSCLC and pancreatic cancer. Zenocutuzumab blocks HER3-NRG1, disrupting HER2/HER3 signaling. Phase 2: 158 patients (93 NSCLC, 36 pancreatic); ~30% NSCLC response (median 12.7 mo), 42% pancreatic (median 7.4 mo). Mild toxicities (diarrhea, fatigue, nausea, anemia). Confirmatory studies required under accelerated approval.

hits.title: eVOLVE-HNSCC volrustomig LA-HNSCC Phase 3
hits.passage: eVOLVE-HNSCC (NCT06129864, AstraZeneca): Phase 3, ~1145 patients, volrustomig (MEDI5752) as sequential therapy vs observation in unresected locally advanced HNSCC after definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy without progression. Status RECRUITING. Primary endpoint PFS in PD-L1 expressing tumors (BICR RECIST 1.1).
